description.value:
Cast part of the graft install

Frequency once per patient

Trigger You graft a bio-augment into a patient other than yourself.

Once per patient, absorb 1 point of a bio-augment's Resonance onto yourself instead of them.

As you perform the install, take 1 point of the augment's Resonance onto yourself instead of the patient — your body reads as the site of the echo instead of theirs. This can be done once per patient, ever, and the point moves permanently: it counts against your own Resonance total, not theirs, for every purpose, including your own bands and the donor thread.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Specifically, no rule element models Resonance transfer between two actors, and the transfer itself is This effect changes a different creature's own roll, HP, condition, or item, sourced from the card holder's own passive/item/action. No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass.
